name: FFS_SP_RUN_LOG_DETAILS
description: Used to store planned move activity actions that have not actually been performed for some a logged reason.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Autoincremental unique identifier of the record; the primary key.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Who column: identifier of the action that leads to the non-assigment. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_SP_RUN_LOG.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Who column: timestamp of the action.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the activity that were not assigned. Also the field contains identifiers of the field resources who were not sent to the scheduling engine. Then the IDs of field resources have the negative sign while activity's IDs are positive.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the route where the non-assigned activity was.

columns.name: NOT_ASSIGNED_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Numerical code of the activity non-assignment reason or field resource non-use reason.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
